QuestionStmt.S: A water drop of $0.01 \, \text{cm}^3$ is squeezed between two glass plates and spreads into area of $10 \, \text{cm}^2$. If surface tension of water is 70 dyne/cm then the normal force required to separate glass plates from each other will be

Solution.S:
Given:
Volume of water drop, $V = 0.01 \text{ cm}^3$
Area of spread, $A = 10 \text{ cm}^2$
Surface tension of water, $T = 70 \text{ dyne/cm}$

Thickness of water layer:
$$d = \frac{V}{A} = \frac{0.01}{10} = 0.001 \text{ cm}$$

The force required to separate the plates is given by:
$$F = \frac{2TA}{d}$$

Substitute the values:
$$F = \frac{2 \times 70 \times 10}{0.001} = \frac{1400}{0.001} = 1,400,000 \text{ dyne}$$

Convert dyne to Newton ($1 \text{ N} = 10^5 \text{ dyne}$):
$$F = \frac{1,400,000}{100,000} = 14 \text{ N}$$

Thus the correct option is B: 14 N.
